description: Light's Vigil Level 60 1340 Mana 40 yd range 1.5 sec cast 6 sec cooldown Requires Paladin Requires level 60 Applies Light's Vigil to a friendly target for 30 sec. The caster's next Holy Shock on the target incurs no cooldown and heals the target and their party for 700 to 740. Only one Vigil per Paladin may be active in each party.
name: Light's Vigil
